title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Anime's Video Reveals More Cast, Theme Songs, October 4 TV Debut
content: The official website for the short anime of Shaoh 's I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ( Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ) manga unveiled the main promotional video and visual for the anime on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2's Video Unveils Theme Songs, October 11 Debut
content: The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira 's Mission: Yozakura Family ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) manga unveiled a new promotional video and visual for the second part of the anime's second season on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Tanuki to Kitsune Anime's Video Unveils Cast
content: Frontier Works unveiled a new promotional video for the television anime based on Atamoto 's Tanuki to Kitsune (Raccoon Dog and Fox) manga on Friday. author: ANN

title: Live-Action Look Back Film's Clip Highlights Kyōmoto, Fujino Creating Manga
content: The official website for the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga presented a new clip from the film on Friday. The clip shows Kyōmoto and Fujino creating a manga together.
author: ANN

title: Konami's Project Zircon Deckbuilding Roguelike Game Streams New Teaser
content: Konami presented a new teaser trailer for its Project Zircon deckbuilding roguelike game during its Konami Press Start livestream on Thursday. The trailer previews gameplay footage for the game, but does not announce a release date. The game now has a Steam page , confirming a planned release for PC.
author: ANN

title: Dark Gathering Season 2 to Release in 2027, First Horror Visual Revealed
content: Dark Gathering Season 2 revealed the first in a series of new “horror visuals,” along with confirming a 2027 release date. Studio OLM was previously confirmed to be returning to animate, with Hiroshi Ikehata as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Game Streams 'Bloody Tears' Trailer
content: Konami unveiled during the Konami Press Start livestream on Thursday a trailer for Castlevania : Belmont's Curse, a new game in its Castlevania series. The "Bloody Tears" trailer is named after the series' iconic musical track: The voice cast includes: • Abby Trott as Rose Belmont • J.B.

title: Shonen Jump’s Next Live-Action Movie Confirms Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content: Live-action adaptations of Shonen Jump series have become increasingly common in the past few years, so it is not surprising that some of the most unexpected contenders are also receiving this treatment.
author: ComicBook

title: Konami Unveils Concept Trailer for Konami Wai Wai World Craft Game Creation System
content: Konami unveiled during its Konami Press Start livestream on Thursday a concept trailer for Konami Wai Wai World Craft , a new user-generated content (UGC) game platform that features characters from various Konami franchises.
author: ANN

title: GKIDS Responds to Incorrectly Timed Subtitles During The Last Blossom Film Screenings, Reviews Options for Makeup Screenings, Confirms cocoon Anime Will Screen as Planned
content: "On Sunday, GKIDS became aware of a subtitling glitch in our DCP for The Last Blossom . We immediately instructed theaters to remove shows from sale and issue refunds to affected customers until we could identify and resolve the issue. On Monday, we were able to provide a corrected version of the film to theaters.
author: ANN
